messages:
maya: Quick heads up — weve got ~20 trial + renewal customers reporting worse answer relevance on private v2-quant deployments since 2026-03-10. Small spike in hallucinations.

jonah: Saw alerts. Root cause: packaging regression in v2-quant that mis-handles padding for certain seq lengths, leading to stale KV cache reads. Confirmed in repro harness.

maya: Need a short customer note + rollback instructions for self-managed clusters, and CS follow-up for renewals. Keep messaging clear: what happened, impact, steps, ETA, credit offer.

priyanka: Add ops checklist: exact command, expected node downtime, where to send logs if restart fails. High-touch customers will want a play-by-play.

jonah: Rollback plan for private clusters (recommended):
```
redwoodctl model pin --model v2-quant-rollback
redwoodctl restart-model --model v2-quant-rollback --grace 30s
```
Model loader logs: /var/log/redwood/model-loader.log. Node restart: ~45-90s; cluster recovery: ~10-25m.

maya: Draft customer note (short):

"Hello — were contacting you about a recent drop in answer relevance seen on the v2-quant model in private deployments. We identified a packaging regression that affected some sequence-lengths and caused stale cache lookups, leading to reduced answer quality.

What were doing: rolling back affected clusters to a verified build (v2-quant-rollback) and restarting model workers. If you self-manage, you can run the commands below; otherwise we will coordinate the rollback for you.

Commands:
redwoodctl model pin --model v2-quant-rollback
redwoodctl restart-model --model v2-quant-rollback --grace 30s

If a restart fails, please send /var/log/redwood/model-loader.log to cs@redwood.ai.

ETA: most clusters will be back within 2 hours of rollback start.

Compensation: were offering a one-time service credit for impacted renewals; your CS rep will follow up.

If youd like help running the rollback, join office hours today at 10:30 PT.

— Maya, Customer Success"

derek: Legal reviewed. Keep "one-time service credit" phrasing only; no dollar amounts or refund promises.

linda: Sales/AMs — prepare targeted follow-ups for renewal cohort. Ill share affected list + renewal dates.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-138 | severity: P2 | owner: eng-runtime

jonah: Starting rollout to first batch (4 nodes) now. Will report health.

maya: Ill wait for first-cluster confirmation before sending customer note.

jonah: Update: first cluster healthy at +12m, relevance metrics back to baseline. Continuing rollout.

maya: Sending initial status to customers at 10:30 PT with commands and office hours link. Eng, please ping if any abnormal behavior.

priyanka: Ill triage private deployment help requests once CS starts outreach.

maya: Action items: eng confirm when rollout finished, legal & sales finalize credit wording + list, CS send update and follow-ups to renewal accounts.

jonah: Will confirm rollout completion in this thread when done.
